integrity: The all-parameter statement is proved from the finite-field factorization, product-algebra automorphism structure, multiplication characteristic polynomials, and Burnside counting. Finite computations are used only as stress tests. Literature comparison is bounded and residual overlap risk is stated.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to prime-order cyclic groups in the nonmodular case. No claim is made for composite cyclic groups, modular group algebras, or noncommutative group algebras.
title: Multiplication spectra classify algebra-automorphism orbits in prime cyclic group algebras
